name: mammoth_dig_layout
description: Hot Springs Mammoth Site dig (040) seen from above as a clean museum layout: tan sediment #d9b77a with a darker excavated bone bed, white grid strings in 150-unit squares with wooden stakes and lettered tags, cream mammoth bones lying in place (high skull dome with two curved tusks, long bones, a pelvis, a vertebra row, ribs), wooden walkway along the bottom. No animals, no people. 1500x800, anchor centre (fills most of a 1080p frame at scale 1).
